evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence_status is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS and fresh-within-2h=false.
No per-strategy, per-chain realized NET P&L distribution after all entry and exit costs.
No finalized EVM wallet-delta reconciliation covering reverts, replacements, gas, builder or profit fees and failed attempts.
No Solana contemporaneous entry and exit quote, simulation, priority-fee, price-impact, sellability and inclusion evidence.
No chronological out-of-sample or holdout results, drawdown, tail-loss, capital exposure or money-weighted return series.
No opportunity-level separation of STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
No evidence relating quote age or execution latency to realized P&L, slippage or success.

Before promotion, require fresh cost-complete runtime evidence, finalized reconciliation, failure attribution, per-chain holdout results, sufficient independent observations and confirmation that all safety gates remained enforced.

proposals.downside_risk: Promotion decisions will take longer and sparse strategies may remain in SHADOW for extended periods.

evidence.detail: PROMOTION_CANDIDATE depends on window count, trade count, aggregate net profit and profit factor, but does not require realised outcomes, out-of-sample provenance, complete-cost flags, chain segmentation or zero unresolved execution failures.
Quote simulations are correctly marked promotion_evidence=0, demonstrating that the architecture already recognises simulated economics as insufficient.
Execution failures are reported separately as EXECUTION findings, but the same strategy can still enter the promotion-candidate branch.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents incomplete or execution-contaminated evidence from producing premature promotion candidates while preserving abstention when no edge exists.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 3 independent out-of-sample windows and 8 cost-complete outcomes per strategy-chain pair, plus explicit reporting of execution attempts, failures and failure costs; these are architectural minima, not proof of profitability.
proposals.rationale: Strategy/market losses and execution/infrastructure failures must remain separately measurable, while promotion must be fail-closed unless net P&L is realised, cost-complete and independently out-of-sample.
proposals.shadow_test: Create chronologically separated SHADOW windows tagged with chain, outcome provenance and cost completeness. Require realised or delayed mark-out net P&L after entry and exit fees, slippage, impact, gas or priority fees, failed-attempt costs and reconciliation. Fail the test if any incomplete-cost, simulated-only, in-sample or unresolved execution-failure window can produce PROMOTION_CANDIDATE.

proposals.downside_risk: Finalized reporting is delayed and some historical rows may remain unscored because reconciliation evidence is unavailable.

evidence.detail: SUCCESS, SUCCESS_FEE_PENDING and BROADCAST are all treated as executed, and realised_net_base falls back to expected_net_base when absent.
Scanner rows initially carry estimated_gas_base=0, simulation_ok=false and sellability_ok=false; they are discovery candidates rather than cost-complete executable outcomes.

EVM edge subtracts gas, builder fee, slippage and price impact and requires exact quote, simulation, liquidity, sellability and whole-route approval, which is an appropriate fail-closed entry architecture.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces durable EVM strategy attribution based on finalized balance deltas and makes execution failures visible without misclassifying them as market losses.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 finalized opportunities per EVM chain across multiple congestion and liquidity periods, including all failed attempts and no expected-net substitutions; require a holdout period before any promotion claim.
proposals.rationale: Expected profit on a broadcast or fee-pending transaction is not realised net P&L. Reverts, replacement transactions, gas paid on failures, profit-fee settlement and final balance reconciliation materially change EVM economics.
proposals.shadow_test: In SHADOW reporting, compare expected edge with finalized per-route wallet deltas after buy/cycle gas, priority or builder payments, protocol fees, slippage, price impact, reverted-attempt gas and profit fees. Stop and classify EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE if reconciliation is missing or fails; classify STRATEGY/MARKET only when execution completed as designed and finalized net is non-positive.

proposals.downside_risk: Extra quote and simulation requests add API load, observations may decay before execution, and conservative round-trip reserves may reject most signals.

evidence.detail: Solana observations intentionally set gross edge, fees, slippage, price impact, liquidity and sellability to zero and mark needs_quote_feature_adapter=true.
Eligibility correctly requires gross edge to exceed fees, slippage, price impact and latency reserve.
Historical wallet positive ratio is context only and is not converted into current executable edge.

proposals.expected_effect: Enables falsifiable Solana strategy research while continuing to abstain when sellability, liquidity or positive executable net edge is absent.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 independent cost-complete Solana SHADOW observations spanning at least 7 days, with per-attempt stage outcomes and delayed exit mark-outs; promotion additionally requires fresh runtime forensics and independent holdout evidence.
proposals.rationale: Solana cannot be evaluated economically from leader BUY events alone. A chain-specific SHADOW adapter must measure executable entry and exit economics, priority fees and inclusion failures without treating historical wallet success as forward edge.
proposals.shadow_test: At event receipt, capture a fresh executable entry quote and simulated transaction, then record delayed executable exit quotes or mark-outs with round-trip Jupiter/platform fees, priority or Jito fees, account-creation costs, slippage, impact and failed-attempt costs. Reject observations with stale quotes, missing sellability or incomplete fee coverage. Stop the hypothesis if cost-complete holdout net P&L is non-positive or execution failures dominate.

rejected_ideas.idea: Lower net-edge, liquidity, sellability or simulation thresholds to increase trade count.
rejected_ideas.reason: More trades do not imply better money-weighted net P&L and would weaken executable-edge protection.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote strategies from quote-simulation profit or historical wallet win rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: Neither is realised, cost-complete out-of-sample P&L.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat broadcast or execution failure as a completed zero-profit trade.
rejected_ideas.reason: This conflates EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure with STRATEGY/MARKET performance and may omit paid fees.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository correctly prioritises money-weighted net results, abstains without executable edge, and provides chain-specific feature adapters. However, promotion-candidate evaluation can consume windows without proving realised out-of-sample outcomes or complete costs, and EVM recording may substitute expected net for realised net on BROADCAST or fee-pending rows. Solana deliberately lacks a current executable-edge adapter and therefore remains signal-only. No profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness conclusion is supported.
